provenance.instruction: In Odoo 17 Sales app (already open, logged in as admin), go to the 'Quotations' menu (under Orders) and click New to create a quotation. In the Customer field, type 'fwod17-n1 Bench Customer' and select the matching option from the autocomplete dropdown (it must actually be chosen from the dropdown, not just typed). Then in the Order Lines tab, add ONE order line: click into the Product cell of the first empty line, type any product name (e.g. try 'Desk' or another product), and select a real product from the autocomplete dropdown that appears. Set the Quantity to 3. Do NOT click Confirm. Save the quotation (or let it autosave) and report: (1) the exact product name you chose, (2) the Unit Price the app filled in for that line, (3) the Untaxed Amount shown in the totals section, and (4) the quotation reference/name (e.g. S00042). Important: this app long-polls so never wait for network idle; wait for concrete elements instead.
